scope: Prevent activating joint work when the second participant's person-company-month unit is already closed.
finding: Joint activation checked the second participant's full-month closure but missed a partial company closure. This could create shared work that was locked immediately by the normal execution guard.
changes: Added one shared isCompanyClosed domain rule for full-month and person-company-month closures.
Joint task activation now checks the second participant's exact company unit.
The existing isClosed and laboratory isLabCompanyClosed helpers use the shared rule.

regression.case: Rejects joint activation when the second participant has closed that company, and leaves task responsibility unchanged.
